item.title: Urinary Tract Infections after Kidney Transplantation and their Associated Factors
item.description: Background: Many of the patients undergoing kidney transplantation (KT) are prone to urinary tract infections(UTIs) due to reasons such as ureter manipulation and damage during surgery, prolonged insertion of urinarycatheters, and developing neurogenic bladder.
